title: prodops_emit_event — Input
description: Player-neutral input contract for the prodops_emit_event tool. Fields derived from the event catalog (specversion, source, type, dataschema, journey, cycle, phase, alters-state, new-state) MUST NOT be provided by the caller.

event.description: Logical event name as defined in events.yaml (e.g. 'Delivery.Bootstrap.Started').

work-item-id.description: GitHub issue number of the Feature being tracked (maps to CloudEvent subject and data.issue).

iteration-id.description: Optional. Iteration Plan identifier for contextual tracing (not forwarded to runtime).

correlation-id.description: UUID that groups related events into a logical execution run. Caller-generated. Used for idempotency check.

execution-id.description: Optional. Player-session-scoped execution identifier for cross-player tracing (not forwarded to runtime).

actor.description: Identity of the player and agent invoking the tool.

player.description: The AI player executing the skill.

payload.description: Optional extra key-value pairs to include in the CloudEvent data block. Must not override catalog-derived fields.
